## QuietPass: one contact per event
1. Set phone, checks, currency and cap in Contact and limits. Use defaultCountry only for national input.
2. Choose the same Bearer Auth credential (your QuietPass server key) on all three HTTP nodes. Never paste it into the JSON.
3. Set operationKey to a stable contact-event ID; reuse it on retry.
4. Run quote-only first. Enable executePaid only after reviewing price/coverage.
5. After a timeout, copy quoteId from Validate quote into recoveryQuoteId. This branch only reads status. Keep the original key and maximum.
6. Connect Contact fields to your own CRM/spreadsheet update. Only map settled results; preserve null and false.
https://quietpass.com/docs/#integration-kit
